answer.reason: The cited source is the BLS QCEW Open Data CSV for West Virginia statewide, 2024 Q4. QCEW API CSV files report monthly covered employment as unrounded, exact counts (e.g., five-digit integers), not figures rounded to the nearest hundred. Option B (30,916) matches the format of an actual QCEW monthly employment value for December 2024, while Option A (32,900) is a rounded figure of the kind found in CES estimates or news-release summaries, not in the raw QCEW data file. Therefore, the December 2024 private-sector covered employment for NAICS 54 in West Virginia is 30,916 covered jobs, and the draft answer (A) is not supported by the cited QCEW data source.
